function loopFor(items)
    local total = 0
    for i = 1, #items do
        total = total + items[i]
    end
    return total
end

function loopForIn(items)
    local total = 0
    for k, v in pairs(items) do
        total = total + v
    end
    return total
end

function loopWhile(n)
    local i = 0
    while i < n do
        i = i + 1
    end
    return i
end

function loopRepeat(n)
    local i = 0
    repeat
        i = i + 1
    until i >= n
    return i
end

function checkBoth(a, b)
    if a and b then
        return true
    end
    return a or b
end
